talks.title: Saturday Night Live Set: Dual Core
talks.teaser: Nerdcore hip-hop icon Dual Core delivers a hard-hitting live concert set on Saturday night at DEF CON 33.
talks.summary:
In this energetic Saturday night live performance from DEF CON 33, nerdcore hip-hop pioneer Dual Core (fronted by Int80) takes the stage to deliver a high-octane set for the hacker community. Opening at 00:01, Dual Core launches into rhythm-driven verses that celebrate hacking history, digital privacy, and open-source culture.

At 09:00, the performance tackles the realities of digital surveillance and online tracking, dropping sharp verses that champion end-to-end encryption, digital civil liberties, and operational security ("Use Signal, use core"). The crowd rallies as the set transitions through fan favorites past 18:01 and 27:02 with spirited call-and-response choruses.

Combining classic hip-hop cadence with authentic technical substance, the concert exemplifies DEF CON's vibrant evening music culture. Dual Core's performance bridges musical artistry and hacker ethos, delivering an unforgettable live show for infosec professionals and fans alike. (AI summary — Gemini Flash)
